verdict.rationale: Docs mention deploying 'custom fine-tuned models alongside standard model variants' via dedicated endpoints, implying serving capability for fine-tuned models, but there is no evidence of an actual fine-tuning workflow/tool on Cerebras (e.g., uploading training data, launching a fine-tuning job) — only the serving/deployment side is documented. missing for 10: evidence of a fine-tuning API/job workflow, documentation on supported base models for fine-tuning, and confirmation that fine-tuning itself happens on-platform rather than elsewhere before deployment.
